title: Learner feedback (contract v1)
$comment: DECISION: feedback is PROFILE-SPECIFIC. The default profile keeps feedback/{uid} (unchanged, so existing documents need no migration); every other profile writes feedback/{uid}~{profile}. Before this contract all profiles of one learner id shared feedback/{uid}, so one profile's asks silently replaced another's (found testing PR #4: the label flipped me -> demo). A legacy document whose label is not 'me' at feedback/{uid} is left alone and never auto-moved: a one-time read-only note is shown instead, because its true owner cannot be proven.

label.$comment: the profile id that wrote it; 'me' for the default profile
